stated: Support pensioners by protecting the triple lock so that pensions always rise in line with inflation, wages or 2.5% – whichever is highest.

source.quote: Support pensioners by protecting the triple lock so that pensions always rise in line with inflation, wages or 2.5% – whichever is highest.

bearing_set.reason: The triple lock directly determines the real value of the state pension, affecting pensioner income adequacy and poverty in later life.

For pensioner households, the state pension is a core component of disposable income used to pay for food, energy and bills; the triple lock's guarantee materially affects their cost-of-living affordability.

Guaranteeing pension uprating at the highest of three benchmarks (including a 2.5% floor) adds persistent, growing expenditure; the IFS and OBR have documented that this materially affects long-run spending sustainability and the funded/borrowed balance.

The ratchet effect of the triple lock causes pensions to outpace wages over time (IFS evidence), systematically widening the intergenerational income gap — an explicit O14 indicator ('intergenerational fairness of gains').

membership_note: Three genuine bearings: O8 is the primary welfare effect; O12 captures the fiscal cost with a named mechanism (structural spending above wage/inflation floor); O14 captures the intergenerational distributional effect documented by IFS. No O2 bearing added separately — pensioner purchasing-power protection is fully housed in O8's 'state pension adequacy' indicator.
